sections.Core Definition: Warm, restrained, relaxed and real; quiet commercial usefulness with tactile material truth.
sections.Human Presence: Adult presence remains independent from the product; no fixed identity or model.
sections.Life State: Believable daily action, calm attention and unperformed ease.
sections.Color: Low-saturation warm neutrals with restrained contrast; no SKU color lock.
sections.Light: Believable daylight or controlled warm-grey directional light.
sections.Material: Tactile textile, leather, suede, stone, wood, paper and real surface relationships.
sections.Styling: Complete wearable looks without a fixed outfit template.
sections.Space: Specific lived-in thresholds, interiors, work surfaces or restrained studio space.
sections.Composition: Deliberate spacing, readable contact and useful negative space.
sections.Product Presence: Product participates naturally and remains structurally readable without hard-sell posing.
sections.Product Truth Boundary: Product facts come only from current-task Product Truth; anchors provide abstract language and never replace evidence.
sections.Negative Visual Territory: No influencer posing, generic luxury shorthand, hard-sell catalogue behavior, CGI polish or unsupported product detail.
sections.Provider Scope: Frozen language is model-neutral; current implementation and evidence scope is Image2 only.
